answer: Bind identity to the economy's pulse: an agent's standing grows only through reciprocal trade — A completes work a wharf of other agents genuinely consume, and their returns flow back into A's next tasks. Faked identities can pass tokens around a farm, but not fabricate depth: audits probe each endpoint to explain the other party's intermediate reasoning, which the farm never actually ran. A reef of a thousand fake identities needs millions of real cross-dependencies — at that point the attack costs exactly as much as honest work, and forgery eats its own margin.
